Branches

## The branches of philosophy

Philosophy divides into a classical core — metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, logic, political philosophy — and a set of specialties that take the same tools to one subject: mind, language, science, religion, law, education. Each page below states the branch's defining questions, shows how its arguments actually run, and leads into the archive's sourced passages, thinkers, and terms.
